profile.migration_strategy_justification: A hosted Yoke tenant gains the logical Stage or Production environment that already identifies its running platform, allowing QA plans to bind without requiring unrelated project-hosting setup.

invariants: A tenant without a yoke project or active Yoke QA plan is unchanged.
At most one yoke project owns the hosted Yoke API site.
The yoke project has exactly one environment matching the Stage or Production runtime across all of its sites.
Repeated apply preserves an existing compatible runtime environment.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration refuses unknown runtimes, site ownership collisions, and multiple runtime aliases instead of guessing. It creates only logical Yoke platform identity and does not claim project hosting is configured.
